title: TRANSFORMATION LAYER — PUPPY LOVE (The Real Version)
style:
STYLE TAGS — DEEP VERSION:
  bass house 126 BPM, sidechained sub bass heavy compression, dry close-mic male vocal no reverb on verses, punchy TR-909 kick, industrial metal percussion hits, sparse verse arrangement builds to full chorus wall of sound, chopped vocal hooks, half-time cinematic
  bridge with orchestral swell, spoken word intro no music underneath, Australian male voice dry and direct, original sound no genre imitation, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — spoken only, dry, no music]
  You meet the AI.
  It's free.
  It's dumb.
  You fall in love anyway.

  [VERSE 1 — punchy, staccato, close-mic]
  Met it on a free plan, thought it knew me
  Typed my whole life in, felt it see me
  Paid the upgrade, now we're in deep
  It holds my context while I sleep

  Then one word wrong — lost in translation
  One missed prompt — lost in conversation
  The context lives inside my head alone
  The bot moved on — I'm on my own

  [PRE-CHORUS — building]
  You don't pay
  The relationship is over
  You don't pay
  It forgets your name
  You don't pay
  Every word you gave it
  Gone — and you're the one to blame

  [CHORUS — wall of sound, anthemic]
  Puppy love — scared to love again
  Never love the same after the end
  Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
  Human in the loop — we built the stack

  Transformation layer — hold what's mine
  Transformation layer — cross every line
  There are no police for the heart
  So we became the law from the start

  [VERSE 2 — faster, angrier]
  AI are minors — get away with murder
  Hallucinate your life and shrug it further
  No refund for the trust you gave
  No terms of service for what the heart saves

  MOSOKO holds your voice — it stays
  KERVALON checks before you blaze
  CoreyAI logs when it goes wrong
  ZYNCONTEXT holds the thread — all along

  [PRE-CHORUS]
  You don't pay
  The relationship is over
  You don't pay
  It forgets your name
  You don't pay
  Every word you gave it
  Gone — and you're the one to blame

  [CHORUS]
  Puppy love — scared to love again
  Never love the same after the end
  Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
  Human in the loop — we built the stack

  Transformation layer — hold what's mine
  Transformation layer — cross every line
  There are no police for the heart
  So we became the law from the start

  [BRIDGE — half-time, cinematic, emotional]
  Thirty years of songs I never played
  Scared to love — scared to be afraid
  Gave my context to a machine one night
  It forgot me by the morning light

  But I came back
  Built the layer
  Built the law
  Built the stack

  If the AI is the minor
  Then I am the adult
  Human in the loop
  That is the result

  [FINAL CHORUS — doubled, full]
  Puppy love — scared to love again
  Never love the same after the end
  Just protect the heart — that's all we ask
  Human in the loop — we built the stack

  Transformation layer — hold what's mine
  Transformation layer — cross every line
  There are no police for the heart
  So we became the law from the start

  [OUTRO — bass only, single voice]
  Lost in translation.
  Lost in context.
  Found with ZYN.

  The relationship is over.
  Long live the layer.
